## Featured Projects

### modcrawl
- **Description**: Fast, ergonomic CLI tool, Rust library, and web interface that crawls Minecraft mod JAR files to discover metadata, identify crash culprits, map dependency trees, and detect duplicate classes or conflicting mixins.
- **Tech Stack**: Rust, TypeScript, WASM, SvelteKit, CLI.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/modcrawl
- **Package**: https://crates.io/crates/modcrawl | https://www.npmjs.com/package/modcrawl

### re-color
- **Description**: Local-first SvelteKit Progressive Web App (PWA) that extracts color palettes from source images and intelligently repaints target images using Web Workers and custom WASM strategies.
- **Tech Stack**: SvelteKit, Tailwind CSS, PWA, TypeScript, WebAssembly.
- **Live Demo**: https://recolor.pages.dev/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/re-color

### inventory-api
- **Description**: Production-grade RESTful inventory management API with granular role-based access control (RBAC), built with Laravel and containerized via Docker.
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel, PHP, Pest, Docker, PostgreSQL.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/inventory-api

### stack-nav
- **Description**: Zero-dependency state-based navigation library for React applications that provides smooth screen transitions and navigation without relying on URL routing.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, NPM library.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/stack-nav

### zipcrawl
- **Description**: Safe, memory-efficient CLI utility and Rust library for inspecting and exploring ZIP archives without full extraction.
- **Tech Stack**: Rust, CLI, Rust library.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/zipcrawl

### Type-Generator (tyg)
- **Description**: Ergonomic CLI wrapper around json_typegen to generate strongly-typed Rust, TypeScript, Kotlin, and Go definitions from JSON, YAML, TOML, and XML.
- **Tech Stack**: Rust, CLI tooling.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/tyg

### hellcat-theme
- **Description**: Dark, charred gruvbox-inspired color theme available in three variants (Hellcat, Hellcat-Oxide, Hellcat-Crimson) for VS Code, GTK, GNOME Shell, and terminal emulators.
- **Tech Stack**: VS Code theme, JSON, Shell script.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SirCesarium/hellcat-theme
